description.zh: 美国中西部与东北部的落叶林、针阔混交林等森林生态系统。该场景的月份是区域指南中的夏秋季窗口，不代表每个地点每年都会出现。
description.en: Forest ecosystems of the Midwestern and Northeastern United States, including deciduous and mixed forests. The month range follows a regional field guide's summer-to-fall window; it does not guarantee fruiting at every site or every year.

note.zh: 美国林务局指南将其列为该地区常见大型真菌之一，记载夏季至秋季结果；结果量受温度和降水影响。
note.en: The US Forest Service guide includes it among common macrofungi in eastern forests and records summer-to-fall fruiting; fruiting varies with temperature and precipitation.
